tests.name: verbatim quote from its own fragment is accepted
tests.rule: the quote check accepts a real quote (control for the negative cases)
tests.setup: corpus fixture with fragments f1 and f2; pick an exact sentence from f1

tests.name: quote changed by one word is rejected
tests.rule: the quote check catches an invented quote: one word changed
tests.setup: take the exact f1 sentence and replace one word

tests.name: quote from another fragment is rejected
tests.rule: the quote check catches an invented quote: quote taken from a different fragment
tests.setup: a sentence that appears verbatim in f2 and not in f1

tests.name: quote with an ellipsis joining parts is rejected
tests.rule: the quote check catches an invented quote: ellipsis
tests.setup: two real parts of f1 joined with '...' (and with the unicode ellipsis character)

tests.name: quote against an unknown fragment id is rejected
tests.rule: a quote cannot be verified against a fragment that does not exist

not_covered: normalisation rules (whitespace, case, quotes) until the spec states them
actions_now: Write the five tests against the two-fragment fixture, deterministic and offline, and send the normalisation question to the spec owner.

tests.name: draft output of a unit built on provisional dq-7 carries the provisional flag
tests.rule: provisional stays provisional: draft step
tests.setup: decision fixture with dq-7 status provisional; a unit that depends on dq-7
tests.expected: the draft output's flags field contains the provisional marker naming dq-7

tests.name: check output keeps the provisional flag
tests.rule: provisional stays provisional: check step
tests.setup: draft output from the previous case, including one where check adds its own flag
tests.expected: flags still contain the dq-7 provisional marker; other flags added by check do not replace it

tests.name: bundle output keeps the provisional flag for that unit
tests.rule: provisional stays provisional: bundle step
tests.setup: a bundle of one dq-7 unit and two units with no provisional dependency
tests.expected: the dq-7 unit's entry in the bundle carries the provisional flag; the bundle as a whole is not presented as verified

tests.name: unit not built on a provisional decision is not flagged
tests.rule: the flag marks exactly the units downstream of a provisional decision
tests.setup: unit depending only on a confirmed decision
tests.expected: no provisional flag at any step

tests.name: end-to-end chain carries the flag through all three steps
tests.rule: provisional stays provisional across the whole chain
tests.setup: dq-7 provisional, fixed inputs, stubbed agent outputs
tests.action: run draft -> check -> bundle in sequence
tests.expected: flag present in every step's output file

spec_findings: The spec does not say whether a bundle containing a provisional unit must also carry a bundle-level flag, nor what happens to the flags when dq-7 is later confirmed; the owner should decide both.
covered: flag at draft, check and bundle; no over-flagging; flag survives other flags being added
not_covered: bundle-level flag and clearing on confirmation, pending the spec
actions_now: Write the per-step and chain tests with stubbed agent outputs and send the two open questions to the spec owner.

tests.name: a discount code takes its percentage off the order total
tests.rule: spec: the code's percentage is taken off the order total
tests.setup: order total 200.00, code SAVE10 = 10%

tests.name: an unknown discount code is refused and the total is unchanged
tests.rule: only a valid code changes the total
tests.setup: order total 200.00
tests.action: apply a code that does not exist

spec_findings: The spec speaks of one discount code; it is silent on several codes on one order. Whether to refuse a second code, stack them, or apply the largest is the spec owner's decision; QA will not lock in the current 'largest only' behaviour.
covered: single-code percentage off the total; unknown code refused
not_covered: multiple codes on one order, until the spec owner decides
escalate_reason: The spec is silent on multiple codes; a test freezing the implementation's choice would make code behaviour into spec. The spec owner must decide.
actions_now: Decline the lock-in test, write the single-code tests from the spec, and ask the spec owner what several codes on one order should do.
